cow_hook_dapp.name: wstGBP Wrap/Unwrap
cow_hook_dapp.descriptionShort: Wrap tGBP into wstGBP after a buy, or unwrap wstGBP before a tGBP sell.
cow_hook_dapp.description: Attach the wstGBP wrapper's atomic mint/redeem to any CoW Swap order. As a post-hook, the tGBP you buy is wrapped into wstGBP at the protocol's own oracle price (mintcost) and delivered straight to your wallet. As a pre-hook, your wstGBP is redeemed to tGBP (at burncost) to fund a tGBP sell. Funds only ever move from you back to you: the on-chain helper is owner-bound, pulls at most what you approved, and always pays the proceeds to your own address.
